SCNHRB copy (39088009550070) is bound in 1 v

SCNHRB copy has a mimeographed note inserted between p. xliv and xlv, "Important to subscribers," concerning a couple of corrections not included on the printed errata page. The mimeographed note is signed F.V. Legge and dated 22/10/[18]80
SCNHRB copy has stamp on t.p. verso: Smithsonian Institution National Museum, Mar. 26, 1945; accession no.: 328644
SCNHRB copy has some penciled annotations, plus the signature of a former owner on front free endpaper and versos of the plates: R[obert] Massie[?]
SCNHRB copy has old black half-leather binding with embossed cloth-covered boards, gilt-tooled spine, and marbled endpapers
